subject: Tier reshuffle: prioritized feature lift and proration
messages:
From: Olivia Ramos <olivia@quantaretail.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@quantaretail.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tier reshuffle: prioritized feature lift and proration

Hi Ben,

We're re-evaluating our Redwood plan ahead of Q4 and considering a move to higher throughput for holiday traffic (targeting 3x current token throughput). Before we commit, a couple of packaging questions:

- Can we migrate to the High-Throughput tier but temporarily remove two add-ons (Advanced Rerank and Realtime Embedding) to reduce monthly cost, then re-enable them after the peak season?
- How does proration work if we switch mid-billing-cycle? Any credits applied or simple monthly pro-rate?
- If we sign a 12-month committed billing arrangement today, what volume/commit discounts are available?

I attached a small usage snapshot from Q3 that shows our peak shapes. Also want to confirm we can keep data residency in us-east.

Goal: get a clear option we can present to finance + legal by EOD Friday. Can you send options with rough pricing + the proposed amendment language for temporary feature suspension?

Thanks,
Olivia Ramos
Head of Product
QuantaRetail

Attachment: usage_snapshot_q3.csv

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Olivia Ramos <olivia@quantaretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@quantaretail.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tier reshuffle: prioritized feature lift and proration

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and the snapshot, that's helpful. Below are two pragmatic paths we see working for QuantaRetail, plus how we handle proration and residency.

Option A — Throughput Plus (recommended for peak):
- Move to High-Throughput tier (3x baseline) with Advanced Rerank & Realtime Embedding removed for the first 90 days.
- Pricing: list price would be $26k/month; with 12-month commit we can apply a 12% commit discount -> $22,880/mo.

Option B — Throughput Lite (cost-first):
- Same throughput increase but keep only core generation (no Rerank/Realtime).
- Pricing: $18k/month; with 12-month commit 8% discount -> $16,560/mo.

Proration: We prorate on a daily basis for the remainder of the billing period and issue a credit or invoice adjustment on the next invoice. So if you switch on Oct 10, you pay a prorated charge for Oct for the new tier and receive credit for the removed add-ons for the remainder of the cycle.

Data residency: we can pin you to us-east for serving; I'll flag the private region on the amendment.

Attachments I'm including: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (draft SOW + pricing table) and feature_matrix_v2.xlsx (shows which module flags are togglable).

If helpful, I'm available for a 30-min sync Thursday (Oct 9) to walk through the amendment and finalize the commitment level. If you confirm a target ARR/commit, I can run the pricing math and request an internal discount approval.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf, feature_matrix_v2.xlsx

From: Olivia Ramos <olivia@quantaretail.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@quantaretail.com>
Date: 2027-10-08T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tier reshuffle: prioritized feature lift and proration

Thanks Ben — that framing helps. Two quick follow-ups:

1) If we sign within 2 weeks, would Redwood consider 15% rather than 12% for the 12-month commit? We're seeking a slightly stronger incentive to lock before holiday planning.
2) Legal asks that any temporary feature suspension is explicitly in the amendment (no data export or usage changes tied to that flag).

We would also like Advanced Rerank turned off for the first 90 days, then toggled back on. Does Redwood require any onboarding work to re-enable?

I'll upload a short doc from our security team with residency and handling expectations — attaching it here.

If you can show a redlined amendment with the proration clause and the 15% option, we can route to Finance. We can do the Thursday call if that's easiest.

Olivia

Attachment: internal_requirements.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-08T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Tier reshuffle: prioritized feature lift and proration — request for 15% exception

Hi Lauren / Rishi — forwarding QuantaRetail's ask. Key points: 12-month commit, expected $150k ARR (approx), ask for 15% vs our standard 12% at that level, and temporary suspension of Advanced Rerank for 90 days (explicit amendment clause). They also need us-east residency pinned.

Pricing sketch attached in the previous email; summary:
- List annualized: ~$312k at list (26k/mo option A)
- Committed 12-mo price at 12%: ~$274k
- Requested 15% would be ~$265k (delta ~9k annually)

Requesting approval to offer 15% on the condition we: (1) limit the discount to the first 12-month term, (2) require auto-renew at a minimum 6-month notice, and (3) add a clause that feature suspension is reversible by Redwood with a 7-day notice if it risks platform integrity.

Can you review and confirm? If approved I'll prepare proposed_amendment_v2.pdf with the redlines and DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Ben

On Thu, Oct 7, 2027 at 11:03 AM Redwood Inference <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> (see original pricing + attachments)

To: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-08T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Tier reshuffle: prioritized feature lift and proration — request for 15% exception

Ben / Lauren — fine to approve 15% under the conditions you set. Add these guardrails:
- Discount limited to first 12-month term only.
- Require a minimum $125k committed annualized ARR threshold (they meet this).
- Include an onboarding milestone (completion of integration checklist within 30 days) tied to the discount being active; if onboarding slips >30 days discount rolls back to standard 12%.

Lauren: please add the SLA/fallback language as Ben requested. Once we have the SOW redline I can sign off and instruct legal to prepare DocuSign.

- Rishi

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Olivia Ramos <olivia@quantaretail.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@quantaretail.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-09T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tier reshuffle: prioritized feature lift and proration

Hi Olivia / Marcus — good news. Internal approvals completed with the following conditions (summarized):

- We can grant a 15% commit discount on a 12-month agreement if QuantaRetail commits to $150k ARR (meets threshold). Discount applies to the first 12-month term only.
- Advanced Rerank will be explicitly suspended for the initial 90 days in the amendment; re-enable request can be made by QuantaRetail and will require a 7-day lead time.
- Proration: daily pro-rate and credit on next invoice; amendment will show sample math.
- Onboarding milestone: integration checklist completion within 30 days required to keep discount; if onboarding exceeds 30 days discount reverts to standard 12%.
- Data residency: serving pinned to us-east region as requested.

I've attached the updated draft amendment (proposed_amendment_v2.pdf) with the redlines and the feature matrix. If these terms look good I'll issue the DocuSign link (https://docusign.com/1234-quantaretail-amendment) and we can schedule the kickoff for Oct 16.

Please confirm and I'll send formal DocuSign paperwork.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
